primaryTextChecks.text: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

context.text: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.
